title: Correlated decoherence in a common environment activated by relative motion
summary: We study two spatially separated boundary subsystems coupled to a common structured environment under relative motion within a Gaussian open-system framework. By integrating out the environment, we obtain an influence functional governed by a dressed environmental correlator evaluated at the boundary positions. Its retarded and Hadamard components govern coherent mediation and correlated fluctuations, respectively.
